items.text: I am exited about the game and its content but the sprite work is so hard on my eyes. I'm happy about the 3d navigation but it is way too extreme with the artwork to make it enjoyable. After an hour and a half I have a headache from the eye strain. while I want to keep going I just can't
items.text_zh: 我对这款游戏及其内容感到兴奋，但像素美术太刺眼了。我很高兴有 3D 导航，但美术风格太过极端，让人无法享受。一个半小时后，我因为眼睛疲劳而头痛。虽然我想继续玩下去，但我就是做不到。

observations.description: 精灵图对眼睛造成负担，导致头痛。
observations.evidence: the sprite work is so hard on my eyes
observations.evidence_zh: 那些精灵图对我的眼睛来说太难受了
